From 312c816c6bc30342bc30dca0d6db617ab4d3ae4e Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Oleksij Rempel <o.rempel@pengutronix.de>
Date: Thu, 5 Mar 2026 15:34:29 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] net: usb: lan78xx: fix WARN in __netif_napi_del_locked on
 disconnect

Remove redundant netif_napi_del() call from disconnect path.

A WARN may be triggered in __netif_napi_del_locked() during USB device
disconnect:

  WARNING: CPU: 0 PID: 11 at net/core/dev.c:7417 __netif_napi_del_locked+0x2b4/0x350

This happens because netif_napi_del() is called in the disconnect path while
NAPI is still enabled. However, it is not necessary to call netif_napi_del()
explicitly, since unregister_netdev() will handle NAPI teardown automatically
and safely. Removing the redundant call avoids triggering the warning.

Full trace:
 lan78xx 1-1:1.0 enu1: Failed to read register index 0x000000c4. ret = -ENODEV
 lan78xx 1-1:1.0 enu1: Failed to set MAC down with error -ENODEV
 lan78xx 1-1:1.0 enu1: Link is Down
 lan78xx 1-1:1.0 enu1: Failed to read register index 0x00000120. ret = -ENODEV
 
diff --git a/drivers/net/usb/lan78xx.c b/drivers/net/usb/lan78xx.c
index f8558b87eaec..19cdf69fa589 100644
--- a/drivers/net/usb/lan78xx.c
+++ b/drivers/net/usb/lan78xx.c
@@ -4552,8 +4552,6 @@ static void lan78xx_disconnect(struct usb_interface *intf)
 	phylink_disconnect_phy(dev->phylink);
 	rtnl_unlock();
 
-	netif_napi_del(&dev->napi);
-
 	unregister_netdev(net);
 
 	timer_shutdown_sync(&dev->stat_monitor);
-- 
2.34.1

## Summary of Modifications

### File modified: `drivers/net/usb/lan78xx.c`

- **Removed** the call to `netif_napi_del(&dev->napi)` in the `lan78xx_disconnect` function (line 4555).

### Relationship between changes

The removal eliminates a redundant NAPI cleanup that occurred *before* `unregister_netdev()` in the disconnect path. Since `unregister_netdev()` already performs proper NAPI teardown (including disabling NAPI and safely deleting it), the explicit `netif_napi_del()` call was unnecessary and triggered a kernel warning (`WARN in __netif_napi_del_locked`) when executed while NAPI was still enabled. By removing this duplicate call, the warning is avoided and the NAPI lifecycle is correctly managed by the standard network device unregistration process.

Here is the root cause:
The driver calls netif_napi_del() in the disconnect path while NAPI is still enabled, which triggers a kernel warning because unregister_netdev() already handles NAPI teardown safely. The redundant netif_napi_del() call before unregister_netdev() is the direct cause of the bug.

Here is the patch:
 
 static void lan78xx_disconnect(struct usb_interface *intf)
 {
 	struct lan78xx_net *dev;
 	struct usb_device *udev;
 	struct net_device *net;
 
 	dev = usb_get_intfdata(intf);
 	usb_set_intfdata(intf, NULL);
 	if (!dev)
 		return;
 
 	udev = interface_to_usbdev(intf);
 	net = dev->net;
 
 	rtnl_lock();
 	phylink_stop(dev->phylink);
 	phylink_disconnect_phy(dev->phylink);
 	rtnl_unlock();
 
-	netif_napi_del(&dev->napi);
-
 	unregister_netdev(net);
 
 	timer_shutdown_sync(&dev->stat_monitor);
 	set_bit(EVENT_DEV_DISCONNECT, &dev->flags);
 	cancel_delayed_work_sync(&dev->wq);
 
 	phylink_destroy(dev->phylink);
 
 	usb_scuttle_anchored_urbs(&dev->deferred);
 
 	lan78xx_unbind(dev, intf);
 
 	lan78xx_free_tx_resources(dev);
 	lan78xx_free_rx_resources(dev);
 
 	usb_kill_urb(dev->urb_intr);
 	usb_free_urb(dev->urb_intr);
 
 	free_netdev(net);
 	usb_put_dev(udev);
 }
